name: Lupin

source.note: Entered from published reviews and guides to Ravenloft: The Horrors Within (and Van Richten's Guide to Ravenloft, which it revises); compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

summary: Towering hybrids caught halfway between folk and wolf, with killer claws and a howl that saps the nerve of anyone near.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.summary: See in Dim Light within 60 feet as if it were Bright Light, and in Darkness as if it were Dim Light.
traits.text: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

traits.name: Feral Pounce
traits.summary: Your Unarmed Strikes can deal Slashing damage, and once per turn a hit can both deal damage and Shove.
traits.text: Your Unarmed Strikes can deal Slashing damage instead of Bludgeoning. Once per turn, when you hit a creature with an Unarmed Strike, you can use both the Damage and the Shove options instead of choosing one.

traits.name: Howl
traits.summary: Bonus Action: creatures within 15 feet make a Wisdom save (DC 8 + Con + PB) or have Disadvantage on attack rolls and saves until your next turn. PB uses per Long Rest.
traits.text: As a Bonus Action you let loose an unearthly howl. Each creature of your choice within 15 feet of you that can hear you makes a Wisdom saving throw (DC 8 plus your Constitution modifier and Proficiency Bonus). On a failure it has Disadvantage on attack rolls and saving throws until the start of your next turn. You can howl a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, regaining all uses on a Long Rest.

traits.name: Werewolf Instincts
traits.summary: Proficiency in Perception, Stealth or Survival.
traits.text: You gain proficiency in one of these skills of your choice: Perception, Stealth or Survival.
